name: TicketSubmissionPage
title: Submit a Support Ticket
description: Public-facing page where end users can submit new tickets with all necessary details, view submission guidelines, and access knowledge base articles.

config.text: Submit a Support Ticket
Please provide detailed information about your issue. Our support team will respond as quickly as possible.

items: Provide a clear and descriptive title for your issue
Include detailed steps to reproduce the problem
Specify the priority level based on business impact
Attach relevant screenshots or files if applicable
Check our knowledge base for existing solutions before submitting

content.text: Before submitting a ticket, check our Knowledge Base for common solutions and FAQs. You can also view your existing tickets to track progress.

config.text: After submission, you'll receive a confirmation email with your ticket number. You can track your ticket status from the My Tickets page.

name: UserTicketListPage
